# S2 Product state model

SYSTEM · S2

# Product state model

Three independent lanes inside the reader. Each lane holds at most one state, so overlays can’t pile up.
Library ⇄ Reader(book) **open** 1 click, ⌘O, OS file · **back** ⌘L or Library button · position saved on exit
**Chrome** exactly one
Immersive ⇄ Controls visible
**show** pointer at top/bottom edge 150 ms · centre tap · Tab
**hide** page turn · Esc · 3 s after leaving the edge · never while focused
**Docked panel** 0 or 1 · part of layout
None ⇄ Navigator · Contents | Search | Notes | extension tab
**open** ⌘T · ⌘F · ⇧⌘A or top-bar buttons (switches tab if open) · **close** Esc · × · hides chrome while open
**Floating layer** 0 or 1 · over the text
None → Aa popover Go to Selection bar → Note card Footnote peek Image view ⌘K palette
**opening one closes the current one** · a page turn closes it (a note card saves first) · starting a selection dismisses popovers and peeks · ⌘K suspends reader input
**Orthogonal** persisted settings
Pages | Scroll Paper · Sepia · Night · Auto Full screen Width < 1100 px → Navigator floats and joins the floating lane
Esc pops exactly one level
Floating layer Esc ↓
Navigator Esc ↓
Chrome Esc ↓
Immersive page — Esc never leaves the book
Rules
1 Chrome and Navigator alternate: the Navigator header carries Library, title and progress.
2 Closing any layer returns focus to the text at the same reading position.
3 Search marks exist only while the Search tab is open.
4 Every jump pushes the previous location; Back pops it.
5 Messages queue bottom-centre, one at a time; timers pause on hover or focus.
6 Per book, remember location, layout mode and whether the Navigator was docked.
7 Extensions can occupy a Navigator tab or a menu item — never a new lane.
